rationale: Both use backtracking with a used slice and a shared chain buffer. A is cleaner: it indexes dominoes by pip value so the search only considers candidates that match the open end, handles orientation with a single branch, and handles the single-domino case without a special case. It also documents why trying one orientation for the starting stone is sufficient. B repeats the mark, append, recurse and undo block four times, twice in extend and twice in the starting loop, scans every domino at each step, and special-cases n == 1. B is correct, but A has less duplication and a better-reasoned search.
